summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 24, 2026 press release announcing a share capital increase of 97,089 Class A common shares ($0.01 par) issued upon exercise of Restricted Share Units under its incentive program. Of the new shares, 95,700 were subscribed in cash at DKK 179.80 each and 1,389 at DKK 124.20 each, raising capital by roughly $2.9 million equivalent. The issuance is without pre-emption rights; new shares carry ordinary dividend and voting rights, with listing on Nasdaq Copenhagen expected shortly. Post-issuance capital totals $1,026,507.77 across 102,650,777 A-shares. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics apply; watch only routine dilution and registration statement incorporation by reference.
